claims.assertion: Yazhi says soul-frequency compatibility selects a body’s species; when growth breaks compatibility, a soul may enter another species, remain astral, or form a new one.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says consciousness is reflected in DNA; enough mutation can change an individual’s measurable biology and species classification.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan parthenogenesis yields genetically identical daughters who share consciousness, perceiving separation only partially until age seven or eight.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She claims temporal mastery lets her alter perceived time and thereby frequency, density, and dimension without a ship.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
